content.intro: M5: Energy Governance for a Just Energy Transition

content.text: This lesson introduces the foundations of energy governance and its central role in shaping a just energy transition. It highlights the key governance principles, and examines how weak governance, fossil fuel lock-ins, and regulatory capture can undermine progress. Discussing the actors in energy governance, the chapter emphasizes that energy transitions succeed not just through technology or investment, but through strong, <ai prompt="Share details about participatory governance.">participatory governance 💬️</ai> systems that engage all levels of society and ensure fair, transparent, and adaptive decision-making.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Introduction to Energy Governance
lessons.description: This lesson defines governance and energy governance, emphasizing their critical role in shaping decision-making, managing trade-offs, and ensuring a just energy transition, and discusses the three principles of effectiveness, inclusinvess and accountability

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Political economy And Energy Governance
lessons.description: This lesson discusses the significance of policy coherence to align policies across sectors to prevent conflicts and maximize synergies, exploring key pillars‚Äîincluding institutional capacity, partnerships, data analysis, and coordination mechanisms‚Äîthat enhance effective governance for sustainable energy transitions.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Energy Governance and International Climate Policy
lessons.description: This chapter introduces energy governance principles and frameworks essential for guiding just energy transition while addressing economic, social, and environmental inequalities.
